company_profile: A bank payments company that helps businesses collect and send Direct Debit, real-time and open banking payments, with ML to improve payment success and prevent fraud.
title: Senior Data Scientist
summary: Senior Data Scientist with 8+ years owning ML models end to end, from deep-dive analysis and feature engineering to production deployment and monitoring, across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps. Builds gradient-boosting prediction, anomaly detection and deep learning models with Python, SQL, PySpark and GCP, and has paired LightGBM scoring with LLM explanations for fraud detection. Translates complex ML clearly for product and business stakeholders. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

experience_edits.new: Deployed a production SLA breach prediction system with LightGBM, FastAPI and MLflow, from feature engineering to real-time scoring, using GPT-3.5 for root-cause analysis per breach, reducing downtime by 67%.

experience_edits.new: Developed an XGBoost propensity model predicting personal-loan applications within 7 days of contact, enabling targeted outreach and customer prioritization in lending.

project.name: Payment Fraud Sequence Model
bullets: Built a payment fraud detection model that learns from each payer's transaction sequence with an LSTM, combined with LightGBM on engineered account features to flag suspicious debits.
Validated with time-based splits, precision-recall analysis and a simulated A/B rollout, then served scores through FastAPI on GCP Vertex AI with drift monitoring in MLflow.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Senior Data Scientist role in the Payment Intelligence team at GoCardless. As a data scientist I have owned models from the first vague question through feature engineering to production and monitoring. The common thread is building models that make a live decision and then proving they help.

GoCardless moves payments for businesses of every size, and stopping payer fraud without blocking good payments is a problem where data science decides the outcome directly. I have also worked on fraud detection in my own projects, so the domain pulls me in. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to London together and settle there long term.

I would bring full lifecycle ownership. At Viavi I shipped an SLA breach prediction system with LightGBM, FastAPI and MLflow that cut downtime by 67%. I also built anomaly detection on 15+ KPIs across 500+ network devices with Isolation Forest, which is close in spirit to spotting unusual payment behaviour.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. It reminds me that models only matter when real people can depend on them. I would be glad to talk about how I could contribute to Payer Fraud Prevention.
